kind: governance validation record (registry ledger, NOT a gate)

experiment.clause: Governance (unconditional): registry row + eval artifact for the shipped CollegeSavant stuff_plus lineage; fixes a standing-rule violation (model-audit-program) that predates this program.

lineage.provenance: Vendored college TrackMan xRV-family model (Will's CollegeSavant build); per-pitch-type xRV models scored on 7 TrackMan kinematic features, mapped to a 100-anchored ratio scale. Static payloads; no in-tree trainer regenerates them.

scale_convention.statement: 100 anchors league-average expected run value; 0 anchors the worst observed college xRV. NOT a z-score scale: the measured payload SD is far wider than 10 and the distribution is left-skewed with a long tail toward 0.
collision_warning: THREE different Stuff+ scales exist in this tree and must NEVER be mixed on one surface:
(1) CollegeSavant stuff_plus (these payloads): college TrackMan xRV ratio scale, 100 = college league-average xRV, 0 = worst observed; measured SD ~23-24 per season (see per_season_coverage).
(2) Will's 2026 formula-anchored vintage (NCAA 26 Averages S+.csv + xRV models/): same formula family, DIFFERENT model fit; verified stuff+ = 100*(worst_xrv - xrv)/(worst_xrv - league_average_xrv).

(3) Platform aStuff+ (stuff_plus_aaa.py, data/stuff_plus_aaa.json): LightGBM delta_run_exp on AAA Statcast, scaled 100 + 10z vs the qualified AAA pool. A 130 here is elite; a 130 CollegeSavant stuff_plus is barely plus.

forward_checks.note: First pro exposure = earliest qualifying A/A+ season, >= 20 IP, stored-BF K% (the college_translation.load_single_a gate).

reading: Descriptive record. The shipped lineage is internally consistent with Will's 2026 vintage at the pitch level (r measured above) and its scale anchors are documented; predictive value against pro outcomes is measured separately by the W4 gate ledger (data/college_stuff_translation_eval.json).
